description: This file defines a class `HoverHUDController` which manages a hover-only Heads-Up Display (HUD) anchored to the menu bar. It handles display, dismissal, and interaction with the HUD, including hover effects and opening a chat panel. It also includes a SwiftUI view `HoverHUDView` used within the HUD.

classes.name: HoverHUDController
classes.description: A singleton class managing a hover HUD anchored to the menu bar. Handles visibility, hover detection, presentation, dismissal, and interaction with the WebChat panel.

methods.name: setSuppressed
methods.description: Sets whether the HUD is suppressed, cancelling any show/dismiss operations if suppressed.

methods.name: statusItemHoverChanged
methods.description: Handles hover state change over the status item, scheduling the HUD to show or dismiss accordingly.

methods.name: panelHoverChanged
methods.description: Updates hover state over the panel, scheduling dismissal if the cursor leaves.

methods.name: openChat
methods.description: Opens the chat panel by interacting with WebChatManager.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the HUD with an optional reason, performing animations and cleanup.

methods.name: scheduleDismiss
methods.description: Schedules the HUD to dismiss after a delay if not hovered.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Ensures the window exists and presents the HUD with animation.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates the panel window if it doesn't exist and configures it.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the position frame for the HUD based on the anchor provider or defaults.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's frame to the target position, optionally with animation.

methods.name: installDismissMonitor
methods.description: Adds a global event monitor to dismiss the HUD when clicking outside.

methods.name: removeDismissMonitor
methods.description: Removes the global event monitor for dismissal.
